description.zh:
ACR企业版实例的访问凭证配置信息。    

> 使用ACR个人版实例时无需配置该参数；使用ACR企业版实例时必须配置该参数。
description.en:
The access credential configurations for the ACR Enterprise Edition instance.

> You do not need to configure this parameter if you use an ACR Personal Edition instance. You must configure this parameter if you use an ACR Enterprise Edition instance.
The ARN information required for authorization.
The ECI instance for which you want to create a CommitContainer task.

description.zh: 要制作镜像的容器的名称。
description.en: The name of the container that you want to use to create the image.
The information about the container image.

descriptions.zh: 调用CommitContainer接口前，您需要准备好ACR镜像仓库，然后创建RAM角色并完成授权操作。具体操作，请参见[提交容器生成镜像并推送到ACR](~~473046~~)。
descriptions.en: Before you call the CommitContainer operation, prepare an ACR image repository. Then, create a Resource Access Management (RAM) role and grant the required permissions. For more information, see [Create an image from a container and push it to an ACR repository](~~473046~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eci commit-container --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --container-group-id eci-bp1do4xz75fa5sd0000 --container-name container-1 --image Repository=registry-vpc.cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/test/test-0000 Message=test_commit Author=alice Tag=0.0.6 --acr-registry-info ArnService=acs:ram::1609982529000000:role/role-test InstanceId=cri-nwj395hgf6f30000 RegionId=cn-hangzhou ArnUser=acs:ram::1298452580000000:role/role-test --arn RoleType=service RoleArn=acs:ram:xxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eci CommitContainer --region cn-hangzhou --AcrRegistryInfo.InstanceId 'cri-nwj395hgf6f30000' --Arn.RoleType service --AcrRegistryInfo.ArnService 'acs:ram::1609982529000000:role/role-test' --Image.Tag '0.0.6' --AcrRegistryInfo.ArnUser 'acs:ram::1298452580000000:role/role-test' --Image.Repository 'registry-vpc.cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/test/test-0000' --Image.Author alice --AcrRegistryInfo.RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ContainerName 'container-1' --Image.Message test_commit --ContainerGroupId 'eci-bp1do4xz75fa5sd0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Arn.RoleArn 'acs:ram:xxx' --method POST --force
